off_protocol_step_size_probe.interpretation: A tenfold smaller step removes the endpoint oscillation, but violates the fixed-lr/no-scheduler tiny recipe and is retained only as diagnosis.

off_budget_weight_average_probe.interpretation: Averaging adjacent constant-lr weights suppresses the L1 sign-gradient oscillation without changing the model or loss. A fresh within-2000-step predeclared-average run is required before it can be gate evidence.
